message.toolcanvas.need_material: Put the tool's repair material in the payment slot first.
gui.toolcanvas.place_tool: Put a tool in the top slot
gui.toolcanvas.apply.tooltip: Repaint this tool with your design. Uses 1 payment item.
gui.toolcanvas.apply.no_tool: Put a tool in the top slot first.
gui.toolcanvas.apply.no_changes: Draw something first: the canvas matches the tool's current look.
gui.toolcanvas.apply.free_reset: This is the tool's original look; applying resets it for free.
gui.toolcanvas.reset.tooltip: Put this tool back to its original look, glint and size. Free.
gui.toolcanvas.tool.pen.tooltip: Left-click: paint. Right-click: erase. Middle-click: pick a colour.
gui.toolcanvas.tool.fill.tooltip: Fills an area of matching colour. Right-click fills it with transparency.
gui.toolcanvas.tool.picker.tooltip: Click a pixel to take its colour.
gui.toolcanvas.mirror.tooltip: Paint symmetrically across the vertical centre line.
gui.toolcanvas.original.tooltip: Load the tool's original texture onto the canvas (nothing is applied until you press Apply).
gui.toolcanvas.shrink.tooltip: Halve the resolution (e.g. 32×32 → 16×16). Each 2×2 block becomes its most common colour.
gui.toolcanvas.upscale.tooltip:
Double the resolution (16×16 → 32×32 → 64×64) for finer detail. Your drawing is kept: each pixel becomes 2×2.
Shift+click: smooth upscale (rounds off diagonal edges).
gui.toolcanvas.copy.tooltip: Copy the look of the item in the slot on the left (its custom design or original texture, plus glint colour and size) onto the canvas. Nothing changes until you press Apply.
gui.toolcanvas.apply.free: Apply these changes. Free: only new pixel art costs material.
gui.toolcanvas.glint.tooltip:
Set the enchantment glint to your current paint colour.
Shift+click: back to the vanilla glint.
Only shows on enchanted tools. Free.
gui.toolcanvas.size.tooltip: How big the tool looks on displays, in item frames and when dropped (and in hand if "Hand" is on). Inventory icons stay normal. Free.
gui.toolcanvas.in_hand.tooltip:
Off: Size only applies on displays, in item frames and when dropped.
On: the tool is also scaled when held. Free.
